rows.en: Goh: "Lord Render."
Render: "Tch... Damn Ioannis...
He withdrew after doing nothing but destroying the lower town..."
Doris: "Well, that's about what you'd expect, isn't it?
For a pampered nobleman's son, he did rather well."
Resh: "You're being too kind, Sis."
Doris: "Am I? I just never expected anything from him."
Render: "So they've come after all..."
Barkin: "...Boss. If we defeat the Spirit Mechs,
we'll make a name for ourselves. Then we could get funding..."
Resh: "Barkin..."
Render: "I thought our ideal wasn't fame."
Barkin: "Boss! Do you really mean that?!
Sure, we're sick of the current government.
And we're trying to build a new order with ≪Ze=Ode≫
as our leaders. But that's just a pretext.
We just happened to be heading in the same direction
to achieve our own goals, didn't we?!"
Resh: "Stop! Bringing that up now..."
Render: "...That's true.
All right. In any case, they will stand in our way.
Striking them here won't be pointless."
Barkin: "Boss!"
Render: "But don't throw your life away.
There are people who need you alive. Those children."
Barkin: "...I'm sorry."
Ai: "Touya, I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll act
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll operate alone. I'm leaving your side to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I can't put my life in your hands yet.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice still doesn't
dwell within you! I cannot follow the orders of such a person!
So I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Melissa: "I'll be acting on my own this time."
Cain: "I'll show you my true power..."
Kururu: "I won't forgive anyone who picks on Touya!"
Touya: "That kid..."
Yamato: "Looks like she got aboard..."
Cain: "Tch... Small fry..."
Kururu: "Hah! I'm going to beat you!
Here I come!"
Cain: "What?! What is this power?!"
Kururu: "Heh heh heh... Victory!♥"
Celica: "Cain!"
Cain: "Hello. It's been a while.
Sorry I haven't had a chance to say hello. I've been rather busy."
Touya: "You bastard... How can you act so shameless...?"
Cain: "What are you so angry about?
...Oh, the chancellor?
Heh heh heh. That wasn't me.
It was what he wanted deep down in his heart.
I just drew it out a little for him.
Told him to be more honest with himself."
Touya: "You bastard..."
Celica: "Touya! Don't give in to your anger!
It'll be dangerous if another Burst Prana happens!"
Touya: "...I know.
I'm not a kid who'll stay unable to control his feelings forever."
Cain: "Alforina was destined to die anyway.
When that castle fell. Her death was just delayed a little."
Ai: "Heh heh heh..."
Touya: "Ai...?"
Ai: "Who the hell do you think you are? I don't know why
you're acting so smug, but what you're doing is worse than
politicians obsessed with money and status while keeping their own hands clean.
Even if they're lying, they at least have a pretext.
You don't even have that.
You're just a brat doing whatever he wants!"
Cain: "Ah... That's right. You were close to Alforina,
weren't you? I understand that anger.
I've felt something similar myself.
Heh heh heh. Fine. Hate me.
If it will ease your heart.
That's what I'm acting for, too..."
Ai: "Yes. I'll never forgive you. But this isn't revenge.
It's so nobody else has to go through what I have."
Cain: "Hmph... However you dress it up, it comes to the same thing.
Humans aren't made wise enough
to separate things that easily.
Now... That's enough talk... Here I come."
Barkin: "I'm sorry... Rii... Everyone..."
Cain: "What?! ...Me...
You're saying I'm losing?! Damn it!!"
